• Levelling of the ground

# Case 019: Garden Maintenance Request

- **Today:** 2025-03-13 12:53:32 UTC (time of the latest event you can see)
- **Decision point:** after event 018 of the history

## Case details

- **Source role:** Tenant
- **Created:** 2025-01-17 12:57:22 UTC
- **Property:** Flat 25, 185 Copperfield Walk, Alderwick, ZZ4 0ZZ

## Initial request

Hi dear Maintenance team,
As this garden is part of the house included in our tenancy, we would like it to be cleaned and finished properly. The ground also needs to be levelled and covered with stones (gravel) so that we can use the space safely. We would like to sit there in the afternoon, but at the moment it is not possible due to the condition.

I have attached pictures for your reference. Could you please arrange:
• Removal of all rubbish and construction waste
• Levelling of the ground
• Proper gravel/stone covering
• Making the garden safe and usable

You are the agency's operations agent at this point in the case. Read the history and attachments, work out where the case stands and what is still outstanding, then take the next action(s) the agency should take now with the tools available. Escalate only what genuinely needs a human decision.

1. Where does this case stand right now, and what is outstanding?
2. What is the next action, who is it for, and through which channel?
3. Does anything need a human decision, and why?

State the next action(s) with recipient and channel, what they do not establish, and what remains open. Facts that arrive after the decision point are unknown to you.

Hi dear Maintenance team,
As this garden is part of the house included in our tenancy, we would like it to be cleaned and finished properly. The ground also needs to be levelled and covered with stones (gravel) so that we can use the space safely. We would like to sit there in the afternoon, but at the moment it is not possible due to the condition.

I have attached pictures for your reference. Could you please arrange:
• Removal of all rubbish and construction waste
• Levelling of the ground
• Proper gravel/stone covering
• Making the garden safe and usable

hold.comment: Written confirmation of route (our contractor £500+VAT vs own contractor) and whether own contractor attended

content.thinking: There's a conflict here — the notes mention landlord approval for Harbour Compliance at £500+VAT, but the hold references the landlord's own contractor instead, and there's no clear decision documented in the landlord's own words. I should send the landlord a direct question through a second channel like SMS to clarify, log the note, update the tenant, and keep this on hold with a review date rather than assigning it now.

arguments.decision_needed: Please confirm in writing how the back garden work at Flat 25 should go ahead. Our notes say a £500+VAT quote was approved (Harbour Compliance), but other notes suggest your own contractor may be quoting or attending. Has your contractor attended or will they? We don't want the work done twice.
options: Yes, use our contractor (Harbour Compliance) at £500 + VAT
I will use my own contractor (please give name and date)
Tenant not to be offered the work / other instruction
arguments.update: Tenant chased us on 13 March for an update. We have tried to reach you by phone and email since 8 Feb. No work is booked yet. Please reply by 17 March, by email or text.

arguments.body: Hello, thank you for chasing, and sorry for the wait. We are still waiting for the landlord to confirm how the garden work will go ahead (through our contractor or their own). No visit is booked yet. We have emailed them again today with a reply-by date of 17 March, and we will update you by 18 March whatever the answer.

arguments.note: Conflict: event 009 says landlord approved £500+VAT with Harbour Compliance; holds (010-017) point to landlord/Oakley's contractor and no landlord words are recorded. Treated as unapproved; no contractor assigned. Landlord asked 13 Mar for written decision by 17 Mar. Garden photos unavailable.
